object_description: elongated two-story bar with escape balconies
design_condition: The elongated bar runs parallel to the road, leaves space for the existing buildings, and acts as a shield around a protected courtyard, although a more precise urban-planning setting is desirable.

positive.statement: The project intends to create a clear address and urban development for the existing complex.

position.rationale: Anchored near the bar’s northeastern end as a plausible public address zone.

positive.statement: The formally clear and concise structural concept leaves the interiors practically column-free.

position.rationale: Interior structure is unshown; anchored along the central longitudinal bar edge.

positive.statement: The project has great floor-plan potential and good space and volume efficiency.

position.rationale: Broad planning judgment distributed toward the bar’s northeastern half.

positive.statement: It promotes open forms of learning and can respond to educational requirements and concepts.

position.rationale: Learning spaces are unshown; placed within the southwestern longitudinal portion.

positive.statement: The lowered auditorium creates interesting spatial and visual references and enables a two-story appearance.

position.rationale: Auditorium is not distinguishable; low-level anchor follows the central bar edge.

positive.statement: The careful use of floor space and building volume produces an economically optimized building.

position.rationale: Economic optimization is a non-spatial performance judgment.

negative.statement: The building is too narrow for the specified spatial program, especially in the access zones, and produces partly impractical room configurations.

position.target: narrow access zones and impractical room configurations
position.rationale: Access conditions are unshown; anchored at the bar’s southwestern end.

negative.statement: An even more precise urban-planning setting would be desirable.

position.rationale: Site context is absent; placed along the northern perimeter as a broad urban edge.

negative.statement: The peripheral placement of the bicycle parking spaces is unfavorable for sustainability reasons.

position.rationale: Parking is not represented; constrained to the western-southwestern perimeter.

negative.statement: The proposed car-parking arrangement on the neighboring plot cannot be implemented in this way.

position.target: car-parking arrangement on the neighboring plot
position.rationale: Neighboring parking is absent; anchored outside the northeastern building edge.

negative.statement: The facades and the prominent escape systems are not convincingly conceived or integrated.

position.rationale: Longitudinal facade and repeated balcony bands are visible, while escape systems remain indistinct.

negative.statement: Implementation of the spatial concept requires a general revision, including a reconsideration of the overall dimensions.

position.rationale: The elongated footprint and repeated elevations directly expose the building’s overall proportions.
